patch.summary: Snov.io implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Snov.io by mapping current sales-intelligence workflows to Snov.io objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on HubSpot

blocks.heading: Snov.io day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Snov.io setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for prospecting, data enrichment, email sequences before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Budget SMB teams that need email finder + verifier + cold email sequences in one seat before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate HubSpot and Salesforce before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led
Do not expand seats until prospecting is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Contact database depth is lighter than ZoomInfo/Apollo-class breadth claims

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Lead scoring is limited versus enterprise SI platforms

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Reporting is lighter than ABM analytics suites

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Snov.io plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

blocks.title: Validate sales-intelligence fit before a deep Snov.io rollout
blocks.body: If Snov.io fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
If blocked, evaluate Apollo.io before sunk-cost expansion
